prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one production game prop sprite: a single short, partly burned ivory beeswax candle in an antique brass chamberstick, including its small lit flame. Intended for an elegant first-person nineteenth-century tavern card game with dark walnut, aged parchment playing cards and subdued amber light. Photorealistic painterly craftsmanship, detailed melted wax folds and drips, uneven softened candle rim, dark charred wick, tiny warm teardrop flame, scratched and tarnished brass, a shallow round saucer base with raised lip and one small curved carrying handle on the right. Candle is modest and stout, not a tall church candle; candle body about twice the height of the brass base. Warm but muted patina, subtle soft highlights, no shiny new gold, no low-poly or cartoon appearance. Camera sees the front and the upper surface of the saucer from about 30 degrees above table level, nearly orthographic product view, entire prop from flame tip to saucer base visible, centered, tight framing with only a small transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha background, clean finely antialiased silhouette, no surrounding table or room, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the prop, no checkerboard, no fog, no large bloom halo. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logo, other objects, or border. The candle and holder must form one physically connected coherent object. Save as transparent PNG.
processing: Resize to at most 768 pixels tall and WebP encoding; preserve original alpha and source PNG.
